title: Checkout Observability Review
prompt: Find the logging bug before this checkout event reaches production.

files.healthyExplanation: The payload builder keeps the event fields explicit and avoids mixing unrelated telemetry concerns into the formatter.
lines: def record_checkout(event: dict, logger: logging.Logger) -> dict:

findings.explanation: Passing the payload as a positional logging argument asks Python logging to format the message. With no placeholder, the event can fail formatting instead of becoming structured context.

healthyNotes.explanation: Using a timezone-aware clock is healthy because event timestamps should preserve the time basis used in production telemetry.
